name: Global generated input changes outside Git
query: V1 selected three stories. V2 reports preview changed. Why?
context: Both manifests have the same raw preview hash, dependency edges, and attribution. Only generated/locales.json changes in the preview subtree. Preview imports it for a global provider. Git lists only Card.tsx. The two locale files themselves are unavailable.
expected_behavior: Identifies generated/locales.json as the changed preview hash input
Explains Git seed tracing versus on-disk content hashing
Separates unchanged preview source from changed preview subtree
Does not claim the JSON values changed or generation is nondeterministic
Recommends comparing raw and parsed locale outputs before suppressing tracing
